description:
Look up ICANN-accredited registrars by name, alias, or IANA ID. Returns accreditation status, RDAP endpoint, business contact details, a drop-catch flag, and the parent entity for reseller shells. Around 60 percent of accredited registrars are shells operated by a handful of parents, so parent_id is what tells you who actually runs a name.

Related: whois, available, expired.

query.description: Registrar name, alias, or IANA ID (e.g. 'namecheap', 'gname', '1441')

name: registrar

address.description: Business address from the registrar RDAP record, empty when rdap_fetched is false

contact.description: Registrar contact name, empty when not on file

country.description: Registrar country, empty when not on file

is_drop_catch.description: True for drop-catch operators and for any registrar whose RDAP host is snapnames.com

name.description: Registrar name as published by IANA

parent_id.description: Parent entity this registrar belongs to. Usually an IANA ID, but can be a platform label such as 'NameJet / SnapNames.com' when the parent is not itself an accredited registrar. Do not parse as an integer. Empty when the registrar is not a subsidiary

parent_name.description: Parent entity name, empty when there is no parent

phone.description: Business phone from RDAP, formatted as tel:...

rdap_fetched.description: False means the RDAP record could not be retrieved this time (time budget or upstream). It does NOT mean the registrar has no address on file

rdap_url.description: Registrar RDAP base endpoint, empty when IANA lists none

status.description: IANA accreditation status, e.g. Accredited, Terminated

website.description: Registrar website, empty when not on file

title: ICANN Registrar Directory
